result.summary: Shrivana Textile Mills has three open overdue notifications totaling INR 21.0M across two policies (WT and SCF), the oldest being a 50-day-past-due invoice of INR 11.0M (original due 2026-10-04) under policy TCI-WT-2026-0001. Historical resolutions show days-late climbing from 10 to 14 to 22 days over the past three cycles, and notification volume has doubled in the last six months (4 vs 2 in the prior window) across two policies simultaneously, indicating broadening payment stress. Combined exposure (21.0M open) remains within the aggregate 100.0M credit limits, but the lengthening delays and multi-policy clustering warrant closer monitoring or limit tightening.
concerns: Oldest open overdue is 50 days past due (11.0M INR) with no sign of imminent resolution

Notification frequency has doubled in the last 6-month window (4 vs 2) and now spans two policies (WT and SCF), suggesting broader cash-flow strain rather than an isolated dispute
